description: On a quiet village street at misty sunrise, a large adult male red deer with wide branching antlers stands on a zebra crossing, raises his head and calls out, his breath steaming in the cold air. He then lowers his head, looks around and steps forward across the crossing. Several female deer wait further down the street behind him. A black bird flies past a bakery with a striped awning, a van waits with its headlights on beside a striped post with an orange globe lamp, and a church spire rises behind.
